The '''''Arlionne''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] that was a part of the [[Victory Fleet]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Republic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]], and during the [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|Battle of Anaxes]] it delivered the decisive blow against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Bulwark Mark I|battlecruiser]] [[Unrepentant (Bulwark Mark I)|''Unrepentant'']] that ended the Confederate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo's]] [[Foerost campaign|campaign]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. However, the explosion of the latter [[Battlecruiser/Legends|starship]] also damaged the ''Arlionne'', with Screed receiving near-[[Death/Legends|mortal]] injuries in the process.

==Description==
The ''Arlionne'' was a [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]], a part of a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|line]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]].<ref name="EGTW" /> It was 900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long<ref name="NEC Victory" /> and was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
[[File:TerrinaldScreed-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Captain Terrinald Screed received near-mortal injuries aboard the ''Arlionne''.]]
As part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[21 BBY/Legends|20.1 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]]<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Dua Ningo/Legends|Dua Ningo]] and the [[Bulwark Fleet]] of [[Bulwark Mark I]]<ref name="NEC" /> [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]] waged a [[Foerost campaign|campaign]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In response, the Republic launched the [[Victory Fleet]], consisting of two [[Task force/Legends|task forces]] of new ''Victory I''-class Star Destroyers under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="NEC" />

Eventually, Dodonna [[Battle of Anaxes (21 BBY)|cornered]] the Bulwark Fleet<ref name="EGTW" /> over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]], where his task force held out long enough for Screed to carry out an ambush.<ref name="NEC" /> Aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''Arlionne'', the latter captain emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in perfect position to launch a point-blank broadside fusillade that disintegrated Ningo's flagship, [[Unrepentant (Bulwark Mark I)|''Unrepentant'']],<ref name="EGTW" /> [[Death/Legends|killing]] the admiral<ref name="CSWE Ningo">{{CSWECite|II|383|Ningo, Dua}}</ref> and ending the Bulwark Fleet's campaign.<ref name="NEC" /> However, the close range of the attack led to the ''Arlionne''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] being ripped open by the ''Unrepentant''{{'s}} explosion, with Screed receiving near-mortal injuries in the process<ref name="EGTW" /> that necessitated [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] reconstruction.<ref name="NEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Arlionne'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
